scope: Uncommitted working-tree investigation; synthetic sources, disposable PGlite; no deployment or production-data validation.

experiments.hypothesis: Project associations are lost because shared client tokens make explicit sibling names ambiguous.
experiments.observation: A deterministic qualifier regression failed before the fix and passed after it; independent nested-name mentions remain ambiguous.

experiments.hypothesis: Merged PRs cannot originate tasks when no task was previously proposed.
experiments.observation: A persistence regression returned zero proposals before the fix. Qualified merged-PR creation, acceptance, replay, archived identity, 501 historical tasks, unmerged/private events and ambiguous projects are now covered.

experiments.hypothesis: Summary availability ignores structured integration evidence.
experiments.observation: The object detail returned canGenerate=false for artifact-only evidence before the fix. The regression now passes; making the association private disables team-summary generation.

experiments.hypothesis: Explicit task fields are inconsistently represented by the model.
experiments.observation: The explicit assignment live case passed once and then failed because only ownerUserId was emitted. After an explicit assignee/deadline prompt contract, three consecutive runs passed.

experiments.hypothesis: The model necessarily leaves same-meeting completed work open.
experiments.observation: The synthetic same-meeting completion case passed in three runs; this did not reproduce the reported production case.
